ref_get.description: Obtains a reference to an object that may be only weakly referenced (e.g., from a weak table/metatable) without making it strongly reachable.

cleanup.description: Performs a memory management or garbage collection operation that can trigger an emergency collection and reclaim weakly referenced objects.

container_insert.description: Inserts/roots an object into a strong container (e.g., a stack), making it reachable during subsequent operations.
